channel.title: The SIX33 Fuel Journal
channel.description: Faith, discipline and the story behind SIX33 Fuel Systems.

item.title: Seek First: What Matthew 6:33 Means on an Ordinary Tuesday
item.description: Matthew 6:33 is the verse SIX33 is named after. Here's what “seek first” looks like when the day is ordinary, the inbox is full and nobody is watching.

item.title: Why We Put Scripture on Every Packet
item.description: Each SIX33 system carries its own verse. Here's why — and what Romans 12:11, Colossians 3:23, Psalm 23:3 and Psalm 4:8 have to do with energy, focus, recovery and rest.

item.title: A Day on Mission: The Rhythm Behind the Four Systems
item.description: 05:00 rise. 09:00 deep work. 17:00 after effort. 21:00 wind down. The daily rhythm behind SIX33's four systems — and the spiritual practices that belong at each point.

item.title: Rest Is Not Weakness: Psalm 4:8 and the Discipline of Stopping
item.description: Driven people treat rest as a reward for finishing. Scripture treats it as an act of trust. Why SIX33 built a whole system around stopping — and why Psalm 4:8 is on the packet.

item.title: Why SIX33 Is Launching on Kickstarter
item.description: Why SIX33 Fuel Systems is launching through Kickstarter instead of a store, what founding backers get, and what we'll publish before the campaign goes live.
